questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A): सस्ते मूल्य, भारी वजन एवं वजन घटने वाले पदार्थों पर आधारित उद्योग कच्चे माल के स्रोत स्थल के समीप स्थित हैं।
कारण (R) : उत्पादों के मूल्य को कम करने के लिए ऐसा किया जाता है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): Industries based on cheap, bulky and weight-losing material are located close to the sources of raw materials.
Reason (R): It is followed to reduce the cost of products.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is correct because weight-losing raw materials necessitate location near the source to avoid high transportation costs of waste material. Reason (R) is also correct and directly explains why this location strategy is adopted by industries.

questions.text:
'भोजन संग्रहण' की गतिविधि से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. सामान्यतः संग्रहण का कार्य कठोर जलवायुविक दशाओं में किया जाता है।
II. आधुनिक समय में, कुछ संग्रहण का कार्य बाज़ार-उन्मुख है।
III. डेनमार्क संग्रहण क्रियाकलापों का विशिष्ट उदाहरण है।
IV. संग्रहण का कार्य मुख्यतः आदिमकालीन समाज के लोगों द्वारा किया जाता है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements related to 'gathering' carefully and choose the correct option.
I. Generally gathering is practised in the regions with harsh climatic conditions.
II. In modern times, some gathering is market-oriented.
III. Denmark is a classical example of gathering activities.
IV. Gathering is practised mostly by primitive societies.

options.A: I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.B: I, II और III सही हैं।
options.C: II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: I, III और IV सही हैं。

options_english.A: I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.B: I, II and III are correct.
options_english.C: II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: I, III and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Statements I, II, and IV are correct characteristics of gathering activity. Statement III is incorrect because Denmark is not a classical example of primitive gathering; it is a developed nation with advanced agricultural and industrial sectors, unlike regions known for traditional gathering.

questions.text: 'फुटकर व्यापार' से संबंधित सही कथन का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct statement related to 'retail trading'.

options.A: यह केवल नगरीय केन्द्रों में होता है।
options.B: फुटकर व्यापारी संग्रहण और वितरण के केन्द्र होते हैं।
options.C: यह उपभोक्ताओं को वस्तुओं के प्रत्यक्ष विक्रय से संबंधित है।
options.D: फुटकर व्यापारी मुख्यतः अपने विनिर्देशों पर सीधे वस्तुओं का विनिर्माण कराते हैं।

options_english.A: It takes place in urban centres only.
options_english.B: Retail traders are the collection and distribution centres.
options_english.C: It is concerned with the sale of goods directly to the consumers.
options_english.D: Retail traders primarily direct the goods to be manufactured to their specifications.

questions.solution: Option C is correct because retail trade involves the direct sale of goods to the final consumer. Other options are incorrect as retail trade can also occur in rural areas, and it does not typically involve manufacturing to their own specifications.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जलमार्ग 'पनामा नहर' का उपयोग करता है?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following waterways uses the 'Panama Canal'?

options.C: सान फ्रांसिस्को और न्यूयार्क के बीच

options_english.C: Between San Francisco and New York

questions.solution: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. The route between San Francisco (on the Pacific coast of the USA) and New York (on the Atlantic coast of the USA) directly uses the Panama Canal to avoid the long voyage around South America.

questions.text: थोक नौभार के लिए विशेषीकृत पत्तन कहलाते हैं :
questions.text_english: The ports specialised in bulk cargo are called:
questions.solution: Comprehensive ports are those that handle a wide variety of cargo, including bulk cargo and general cargo. While some specialized ports exist, 'Comprehensive' ports are defined by their ability to handle large volumes and varieties of bulk cargo effectively.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित राज्यों को उनके बॉक्साइट के उत्पादन के अनुसार उच्चतम से निम्नतम क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. ओडिशा
II. गुजरात
III. छत्तीसगढ़
IV. मध्य प्रदेश
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following states from the highest to the lowest order according to their production of Bauxite and choose the correct option.
I. Odisha
II. Gujarat
III. Chhattisgarh
IV. Madhya Pradesh
questions.solution: Odisha is the leading producer of bauxite in India, followed by states like Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Madhya Pradesh in descending order of their contribution, making option C the correct sequence based on standard production data.

questions.text: भौमजल संसाधन का मध्यम दर से उपयोग करने वाले राज्यों के सही समूह का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct group of states utilizing their groundwater resource moderately.
questions.solution: States like Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar are classified under moderate groundwater utilization compared to states like Punjab and Haryana, which have very high utilization, or states in hilly regions, which have lower utilization.

questions.text: विश्व की सबसे लंबी राजमार्ग सुरंग, अटल टनल का निर्माण हिमालय की निम्नलिखित में से किस श्रेणी में किया गया है ?
questions.text_english: The world's longest highway tunnel, Atal Tunnel is constructed across which one of the following ranges of the Himalayas ?
questions.solution: The Atal Tunnel, which is the world's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 feet, is located in the Pir Panjal range of the Himalayas, connecting Manali to Lahaul-Spiti valley.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A) : अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार सभी देशों के लिए परस्पर लाभदायक है।
कारण (R) : यह आवश्यकता की वस्तुओं को अन्य देशों से प्राप्त करने में सहायता करता है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): International trade is mutually beneficial to nations.
Reason (R): It helps in getting the needed items from other countries.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: International trade allows countries to specialize in what they produce best and trade for what they lack, making it mutually beneficial. Reason (R) correctly explains this benefit by stating it facilitates obtaining needed items that a country might not produce domestically.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दिल्ली में यमुना के जल का सबसे प्रमुख प्रदूषक है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is the main polluter of Yamuna water in Delhi ?

options.B: घरेलू अपशिष्ट को नदी में डालना

questions.solution: In urban centers like Delhi, the primary cause of pollution in the Yamuna River is the discharge of untreated domestic sewage and waste into the river channel, making option B the correct answer.

questions.text: जल-जनित बीमारियों के सही समुच्चय की पहचान कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Identify the correct set of water-borne diseases.

options.C: आँतों के कृमि, सिरदर्द और रक्तचाप
options.D: हेपेटाइटिस, दस्त (डायरिया) और आँतों के कृमि

options_english.C: Intestinal worms, Headache and Blood pressure

questions.solution: Hepatitis, Diarrhoea, and Intestinal worms are well-known water-borne diseases transmitted through contaminated water sources. Other options include diseases like asthma, headache, and blood pressure, which are not primarily caused by water consumption.

questions.text:
भारत में ग्रामीण से नगरीय क्षेत्र की ओर जनसंख्या प्रवास के निम्नलिखित कारकों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और प्रतिकर्ष कारकों के सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. बेरोज़गारी
II. रोज़गार के अवसर
III. आर्थिक पिछड़ापन
IV. चिकित्सा सुविधाओं का अभाव
questions.text_english:
Read the following factors of population migration in India from rural to urban areas carefully and choose the correct option of push factors.
I. Unemployment
II. Job opportunities
III. Economic backwardness
IV. Lack of medical facilities

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.B: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, III and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Push factors are negative reasons that force people to migrate away from a place. Unemployment (I), Economic backwardness (III), and Lack of medical facilities (IV) are all push factors. 'Job opportunities' (II) is a pull factor that attracts people to urban areas.

questions.text:
"कृषि योग्य भूमि पर दबाव का कारण केवल सीमित उपलब्धता ही नहीं, वरन इसकी गुणवत्ता में कमी भी इसका कारण है।" इस कथन के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कारणों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. मृदा अपरदन तथा जलाक्रांतता
II. मृदा की लवणता तथा भू-क्षारता
III. समृद्ध भू-उर्वरकता और बहुफ़सली कृषि
IV. भूमि की उत्पादकता में कमी
questions.text_english:
"The pressure on agricultural land increases not only due to the limited availability, but also by deterioration of quality of agricultural land." In the context of this statement read the following reasons carefully and choose the correct option.
I. Soil erosion and waterlogging.
II. Salinisation and alkalinisation of soil.
III. Rich land fertility and multiple cropping.
IV. Decline in land productivity.

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.B: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं。

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only II, III and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Deterioration of quality is caused by negative factors like Soil erosion, waterlogging, Salinisation, and Decline in land productivity. 'Rich land fertility and multiple cropping' are positive factors that improve productivity rather than causing deterioration.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से 'नमामि गंगे कार्यक्रम' के एक उद्देश्य का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Choose an objective of the 'Namami Gange Programme' from the following:

options_english.B: To develop the network of canals
options_english.C: To construct dams for water management

questions.solution: The Namami Gange Programme is an integrated conservation mission to effectively abate pollution and conserve the river Ganga. Monitoring and controlling industrial effluents being discharged into the river is a primary objective of this programme.

questions.text: तालिका में दिए गए देशों में निम्नलिखित में से किस महाद्वीप के अधिकतम देश हैं ?
questions.text_english: The maximum number of countries given in the table belong to which one of the following continents?
questions.image_description: A table showing Human Development Index (2021) for 8 countries: Israel, Mexico, Switzerland, Singapore, Cuba, Austria, Germany, Chile.
questions.solution: Based on the table: Switzerland, Austria, and Germany are in Europe (3 countries). Mexico and Chile are in Latin America, Singapore and Israel in Asia, and Cuba in the Caribbean. Thus, Europe has the maximum number of countries in the provided list.

questions.text: अनेक व्यवसायी होते हैं जो फीस का भुगतान होने पर अपनी सेवाएँ प्रदान करते हैं। अतः सभी प्रकार की सेवाएँ विशिष्ट कौशल होते हैं जो भुगतान के बदले प्राप्त होते हैं। स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, विधि, प्रशासन और मनोरंजन इत्यादि को व्यावसायिक कुशलता की आवश्यकता है। इन सेवाओं को अन्य सैद्धांतिक ज्ञान और क्रियात्मक प्रशिक्षण की आवश्यकता होती है। तृतीयक क्रियाकलाप सेवा सेक्टर से संबंधित हैं। जनशक्ति सेवा सेक्टर का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण कारक है क्योंकि अधिकांश तृतीयक क्रियाकलापों का निष्पादन कुशल श्रमिक, व्यावसायिक दृष्टि से प्रशिक्षित विशेषज्ञ और परामर्शदाताओं द्वारा होता है। आर्थिक विकास की आरंभिक अवस्थाओं में, लोगों का एक बड़ा अनुपात प्राथमिक सेक्टर में कार्य करता था। एक विकसित अर्थव्यवस्था में बहुसंख्यक श्रमिक तृतीयक क्रियाकलापों में रोज़गार पाते हैं और अपेक्षाकृत कम संख्या में द्वितीयक सेक्टर में कार्यरत होते हैं।
questions.text_english: There are many professionals who provide their services against payment of their fee. Thus, all types of services are special skills provided in exchange of payments. Health, education, law, governance and recreation, etc., require professional skills. These services require other theoretical knowledge and practical training. Tertiary activities are related to the service sector. Manpower is an important component of the service sector as most of the tertiary activities are performed by skilled labour, professionally trained experts and consultants. In the initial stages of economic development, larger proportion of people worked in the primary sector. In a developed economy, the majority of workers get employment in tertiary activity and a moderate proportion is employed in the secondary sector.

sub_questions.solution: A person can avail the services of a professional by paying the prescribed fee for the specific service provided.

questions.text: (क) मानव के प्रकृतीकरण की अवधारणा की परख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) Examine the concept of naturalisation of humans.

sub_questions.text: (ख) मानव भूगोल के मानवतावादी उपागम की परख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Examine the humanistic approach of human geography.
sub_questions.solution: The humanistic approach in human geography emphasizes the human aspect of geography. It focuses on the importance of human welfare, the experiences of people, and social issues, rather than just objective physical data. It explores how people perceive their surroundings and the impact of geography on human lives.

questions.solution: The naturalisation of humans, often linked to environmental determinism, suggests that in the early stages of human development, humans were completely influenced by nature. Technology was primitive, and people had to adapt entirely to the environment to survive, with nature dictating human activities and lifestyle.

questions.text: आधुनिक समय में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के महत्त्व की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain the importance of international trade in modern times.
questions.solution: International trade is crucial in modern times for the global economy. It enables countries to import goods they cannot produce domestically, promotes economic growth through exports, fosters specialization based on comparative advantage, and strengthens international relations and global cooperation between nations.

questions.text_english: Why does 'solar thermal energy' have greater advantage over 'non-renewable energy' in India? Explain.
questions.solution: Solar thermal energy is highly advantageous in India because it is an infinite and renewable resource, unlike non-renewable energy sources like coal or petroleum which are exhaustible. Furthermore, solar energy is environment-friendly, producing minimal pollution, and it ensures long-term energy sustainability for India's growing needs.

questions.text_english: Analyse any five factors influencing the distribution of world population.
questions.solution: The distribution of the world's population is highly uneven and is influenced by several factors. Firstly, topography plays a key role as people prefer plains over rugged mountains. Secondly, favorable climate conditions, avoiding extreme heat or cold, support larger populations. Thirdly, availability of water has always been essential for settlement and agriculture. Fourthly, fertile soil is necessary to support large populations through farming. Lastly, industrialization and urbanization act as pull factors, drawing people to cities for jobs, hence influencing population concentration in developed industrial regions.

sub_questions.text_english: (b) "Mixed economies have public, private and joint sector industries." Examine the statement.
sub_questions.solution: In a mixed economy, the government and private sector coexist. Public sector industries are owned and operated by the government to ensure public welfare. Private sector industries are driven by profit motives and innovation. Joint sector industries combine both, allowing for shared resources and risks, ensuring a balance between economic growth and welfare.

questions.solution: Ranching is a commercial livestock rearing activity. This organized approach ensures the efficient production of meat, wool, and hides for the commercial market.

key_points: Shift from food to capital goods

sub_questions.solution: India's import pattern has undergone significant changes. Initially, imports were focused on food grains and capital goods to build industrial capacity. Over time, there has been a massive shift toward importing crude oil, technology, electronics, and chemicals. Economic liberalization policies have further diversified the basket, with an increased focus on high-tech inputs and intermediate goods.

They allow users to connect instantly with resources worldwide, facilitating research, education, and social interaction. By breaking geographical barriers, these tools empower individuals to acquire knowledge from various databases, participate in global discussions, and access real-time information, significantly enhancing their awareness and capabilities in the modern world.

questions.text_english: (a) Define the concept of 'Common Property Resource'. Explain any four characteristics of common property resources in India.

sub_questions.text: (ख) भारत में 'सिंचित' और 'वर्षा निर्भर कृषि' में उदाहरणों सहित अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Distinguish between 'irrigated' and 'rainfed agriculture' in India with examples.
sub_questions.solution: Irrigated agriculture relies on artificial water supply like canals, tanks, and tubewells, ensuring stability and multiple crops (e.g., Punjab's wheat). Rainfed agriculture depends entirely on rainfall, leading to seasonal and less predictable production (e.g., dryland millet farming in Rajasthan). Irrigation significantly increases productivity compared to rainfed methods.

questions.solution: Common Property Resources (CPRs) are natural resources shared by the entire community rather than owned by individuals. Key characteristics in India include: 1) Collective ownership, often held by the village community. 2) Open access to all community members for grazing, firewood, or water. 3) They provide essential support to the rural poor, particularly those without land. 4) Management is often governed by traditional social norms and community rules to ensure sustainable use of these shared assets.

sub_questions.text_english: (b) "Population distribution pattern in India is highly uneven." Explain the statement with examples.
sub_questions.solution: India's population distribution is highly uneven due to factors like climate, terrain, and economic opportunities. Northern plains (like UP and Bihar) have very high population density because of fertile soil and favorable climate. Conversely, areas like the Himalayas, the Thar Desert of Rajasthan, and some hilly northeastern states have very low population density due to harsh terrain, extreme climate, or lack of resources.

questions.solution: Population density in India varies significantly from one region to another. While states like West Bengal and the National Capital Territory of Delhi exhibit extremely high population densities due to urbanization, industrialization, and fertile land, states like Arunachal Pradesh and the Union Territory of Ladakh have very low densities. These variations are primarily due to physical features, climate, and the historical development of different regions.
